text: dsh-session-header 是面向 DSH 的 JavaScript 插件：在模型调用时把当前 harness 会话 ID 写入 HTTP 请求头，并可选地为工具执行期间发往指定网关的请求加头。它通过 llm/stream 与 tools/execute 钩子结合全局 fetch 补丁工作，支持自定义头名、固定值、网关 URL 前缀白名单，以及按需覆盖已有占位头。插件默认去掉 session- 前缀；没有会话值时不注入，并在卸载时恢复原 fetch。适合需要按会话路由、缓存或审计模型网关请求的 DSH 用户。安装需要 DSH CLI 和 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

dsh-session-header adds the active DSH session ID to model request headers and can include matching tool requests. Configure the header name, fixed value, gateway URL prefixes, or placeholder headers to replace. Requires the DSH CLI and Node.js 22+.
想让模型网关收到每个 DSH 调用对应的会话 ID。
不同会话并发请求时，怎么把各自的会话标识带给模型服务？
希望所有模型请求都自动附带自定义 HTTP 会话头。
工具调用访问自家模型网关时，也需要传递当前会话 ID。
网关收到固定占位会话头时，怎样替换成真实会话标识？
Add the active conversation ID to requests sent through my DSH model provider.
How can tool calls attach a session header only to my gateway URLs?
I need a configurable HTTP header with a fixed value for model requests.
dsh-session-header 的功能「模型请求会话头」：在 llm/stream 期间，将调用会话 ID 注入 fetch 请求。默认头名为 x-session-id，剥除 session- 前缀；没有 ID 时不添加头。
dsh-session-header 的功能「固定头值」：可配置自定义 HTTP 头名和固定值。设置 value 后，每个适用请求都发送该值，不再使用当前调用的会话 ID。
dsh-session-header 的功能「工具网关白名单」：配置 toolEndpoints 后，tools/execute 期间只有匹配 origin 和路径边界的 fetch 请求带会话头，其他目标保持原样。
dsh-session-header 的功能「替换占位头」：默认保留请求已有的同名头；将头名加入 overwriteHeaders 后，可用当前会话值替换已有占位值，头名匹配不区分大小写。
dsh-session-header 使用工具执行期注入时，必须配置 toolEndpoints URL 前缀；空配置默认不为工具请求注入，未匹配前缀的第三方目标也不会带上会话头。

dsh-session-header README · dsh-session-header：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that injects an `x-session-id` HTTP header onto **every LLM provider request** the harness sends, carrying the **harness session id of that exact call**.

dsh-session-header README · Why：The harness has no per-request header seam — `GenerateOptions` has no headers field and every adapter builds its own wire headers internally. If your model gateway (or an intermediary proxy) keys routing, caching, or auditing on a session header, the harness cannot send one by itself.

This plugin closes that gap with the two official interception points composed together:

dsh-session-header README · Why：- the **`llm/stream` waterfall** names the calls that are LLM calls and carries `options.sessionId`;
- a **`globalThis.fetch` patch** adds the header, so every fetch-based adapter (`llm-deepseek`, `llm-pi-ai`, and any SDK whose transport bottoms out in global fetch) is covered without touching adapter code.

dsh-session-header README · Why：Context propagation uses `AsyncLocalStorage`: only fetches that happen inside an LLM call's stream are touched; unrelated fetches (web RPC, telemetry, tool traffic) pass through untouched. A header anyone else already set is never overwritten (case-insensitive, per HTTP semantics). Unloading the plugin restores the original `fetch`.

Semantics of the value:
dsh-session-header README · Install：Requires the `dsh` CLI and Node ≥ 22.

dsh-session-header README · As a bundle (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:homily707/dsh-session-header
```

This package is plain JavaScript with no build scripts, so the pnpm ≥ 10 build allowance is not needed. Verify the layer and boot:

```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config   # look for the "# == dsh-session-header" layer
dsh --profile <name>
```

text:
dsh-session-header README · Configuration：| field | type | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `header` | string | `x-session-id` | header name to inject; case-insensitive on the wire |
| `value` | string | — | fixed value; unset = the harness session id of the call in flight |
| `toolEndpoints` | string[] | `[]` | URL prefixes matched during tool execution. When non-empty, fetches inside a `tools/execute` waterfall — e.g. a gateway web-search Messages API called from a tool — get the header only when their URL starts with one of these prefixes; third-party tool targets (web_fetch of arbitrary pages, GitHub, MCP servers) stay untouched. Empty (default) keeps the upstream LLM-only injection. |
| `overwriteHeaders` | string[] | `[]` | Header names this plugin may overwrite when they already carry a value. Everything else keeps the "never overwrite" rule. Some official providers hard-code placeholder values (e.g. `dsh-web-search-deepseek` sends `x-opencode-session: dsh-web-search`), which gateways reject as missing; list the header here (`overwriteHeaders: [x-opencode-session]`) so the live session id replaces that placeholder. Case-insensitive. |

dsh-session-header README · Verify it：Point a provider's `baseURL` at a logging gateway (or any endpoint that echoes request headers) and start a session:

```
x-session-id: ba104306-a748-4052-a6e3-ab60be2e4c1f
```

Every request of the same conversation carries the same id; a spawned subagent's requests carry the child session id.

dsh-session-header README · Notes：- The `llm-deepseek` adapter already sends its own `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` on every request; this plugin is provider-neutral and intentional about not overwriting existing headers.
- `attributionHeaders()` (the harness User-Agent attribution contract) is never touched.
- Concurrent sessions are handled correctly: the header value is resolved per call through AsyncLocalStorage, not through shared mutable state.
